package custom

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type Key int64

func (k *Key) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var text string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &text); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	n, err := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimPrefix(text, "k:"), 10, 64)
	if err == nil {
		*k = Key(n)
	}
	return err
}
func (k *Key) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { return json.Marshal(fmt.Sprintf("k:%d", *k)) }

type TextKey struct{ Value int64 }

func (k *TextKey) UnmarshalText(data []byte) error {
	n, err := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimPrefix(string(data), "t:"), 10, 64)
	if err == nil {
		k.Value = n
	}
	return err
}
func (k TextKey) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) { return []byte(fmt.Sprintf("t:%d", k.Value)), nil }

type HookKey int64

func ParseHookKey(data json.RawMessage) (HookKey, error) {
	var text string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &text); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	n, err := strconv.ParseInt(strings.TrimPrefix(text, "h:"), 10, 64)
	return HookKey(n), err
}
